test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Soiled.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer for the **blank number 2 **is **"soiled." **
 
• When plastic bags are used to carry items such as groceries, they often come in contact with food or other substances, leaving them dirty or soiled.
 
• This makes it difficult to recycle them and can also make them unsanitary for reuse.
 
• So, once they have been used, they often end up in the trash.
 
 
• Example: After carrying groceries, the plastic bag became **soiled **and had to be thrown away.
 
 
 
• **Option 1, "disinfected,"** means to clean something to make it free from germs. It does not fit in the context of the given sentence.
 
 
• Example: The doctor **disinfected **the wound before applying the bandage.
 
 
 
• **Option 3, "moulded," **means to shape something by forming it into a particular shape or form. It also does not fit in the context of the given sentence.
 
 
• Example: The artist **moulded **the clay into a beautiful sculpture.
 
 
 
• **Option 4, "recycled,"** means to convert waste into reusable material. It is a possible answer for this blank, but it does not fit the context of the sentence, which is talking about what happens to plastic bags after they have been used.

 

**Correct Paragraph:**__ *The effects of plastic bags on the environment are really **(1) __quite__** devastating because there is no disposal method that will really help eliminate the problem. The biggest problem with them is that once they have been** (2)** __**soiled**__**, they end up In the trash, which then ends up in the landfill or is burned. The indefinite period of time that it takes for the average plastic bag to break (3)______ can be literally hundreds of years. Throughout the world, plastic bags are responsible for suffocation and deaths of woodland animals as well as (4)______ soil nutrients. The land litter that is made up of plastic bags has the potential to kill over and over again. It has been estimated that one bag has the potential to inadvertently kill one animal per every three months due to unintentional digestion or inhalation. There are always alternatives to plastic bags and the search for more alternatives continues.*
